_comment: Cases that are known to differ from mongod 7.0.45 and why. A case listed here is reported as K (known), not F; the report lists them. Nothing here is hidden: each entry names the cause.
g07.locale.en_US_POSIX: ICU 57 tailors en_US_POSIX to ASCII code-point order; the ICU4X collation data has no such tailoring (root order is used) [proof: compat/gaps_status/icu_locale_proof.md, generated by mongo-tests/gaps/gen_icu_proof.py: same strings sorted by mongod 7.0.45, the engine, and the engine under 'en']
g07.locale.lv: ICU 57's Latvian tailoring (y sorting with i) is not in the newer CLDR data of ICU4X, which orders lv like root [proof: compat/gaps_status/icu_locale_proof.md, generated by mongo-tests/gaps/gen_icu_proof.py: same strings sorted by mongod 7.0.45, the engine, and the engine under 'en']
g07.locale.se: Northern Sami tailoring (a-ring, a-umlaut, o-umlaut after z) is missing from the ICU4X data used by this build [proof: compat/gaps_status/icu_locale_proof.md, generated by mongo-tests/gaps/gen_icu_proof.py: same strings sorted by mongod 7.0.45, the engine, and the engine under 'en']
